title: Hermeus hero
description: A window-tall flat grey ground with a full-bleed render slot (the original's cut-out aircraft) and one short plain headline at the left. On load each letter blurs and skews into focus at a scattered moment, and afterwards single letters keep briefly blurring out and back, like a signal flickering.
notes: 100svh tall; the header sits over its top (page.tsx pulls it up under the sticky header)
the empty media slot is a soft light pooled on the grey ground; a real cut-out image fills it like object-fit: cover
CSS only; with reduced motion the headline is simply shown
name: hermeus-hero
